DEFINE CLASS tg_tabla AS tg_custom OF "tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="custom" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: abrir
		*m: agregar
		*m: agregarymodificar
		*m: borrado
		*m: borrar
		*m: buscar
		*m: cerrar
		*m: desfiltrar
		*m: errorsis
		*m: esbof
		*m: eseof
		*m: esfinal
		*m: esprincipio
		*m: fijartag
		*m: filtrar
		*m: grabar
		*m: haymodificaciones
		*m: incrementar		&& Incremento en uno un determinado campo
		*m: iranterior
		*m: irprimero
		*m: irregistro
		*m: irsiguiente
		*m: irultimo
		*m: leer
		*m: localizar
		*m: lockarch
		*m: lockreg
		*m: modificar
		*m: recno		&& Devuelve el numero de registro
		*m: reindexar
		*m: revertir
		*m: saltar
		*m: selecanterior
		*m: seleccionar
		*m: setearprop
		*m: unlock
		*p: alias		&& Especifica el alias usado para cada tabla o vista asociada con un objeto Cursor.
		*p: aliasant
		*p: buffer
		*p: exclusivo
		*p: registro
		*p: tabla
		*p: tag		&& Almacena cualquier dato adicional necesario para su programa.
		*p: yagrabo
		*p: yarevirtio
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		Name = "tg_tabla"
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE abrir
		lparameters cTabla,cTag,lExclusivo
		local calias,mmpp
		
		this.AliasAnt=alias()
		
		calias=alltrim(ctabla)
		mmpp=1
		do while used(calias)	
			
			calias=alltrim(ctabla)+alltrim(str(mmpp))
			mmpp=mmpp+1
			
		enddo
		if !lExclusivo
			use (ctabla) in 0 again alias (calias) order tag (cTag)
		else
			use (ctabla) in 0 again alias (calias) order  tag (cTag) exclusive
		endif
		
		
		this.registro=1
		this.alias=calias
		go top in (this.alias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE agregar
		append blank in (this.alias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE agregarymodificar
		lParameters vDatos,lResetearVector
		this.Agregar
		this.LockReg()
		this.Modificar(@vDatos,.t.,lResetearVector)	
		this.Unlock
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrado
		local lretorna
		lretorna=deleted(this.alias)
		if lretorna
			=fMensAceptar(TG_REGISTROBORRADO)
			return .t.
		endif
		return .f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrar
		delete in (this.alias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE buscar
		lparameters cDato,lNearOn,cTag
		local cTagAuxiliar,lRetorna,cDatoBuscado
		cTagAuxiliar=""
		*cDatoBuscado=alltrim(upper(cDato))
		if type("cDato")=T_CHARACTER
			cDatoBuscado=Upper(cDato)
		Else
			cDatoBuscado=cDato
		Endif	
		
		if type("cTag")=T_LOGICAL
			cTagAuxiliar=alltrim(this.tag)
		else
			cTagAuxiliar=alltrim(cTag)	
		endif
		if lNearOn
			Set Near On
		endif
		lRetorna=seek(cDatoBuscado,this.alias,cTagAuxiliar)
		if lNearOn
			Set Near oFF
		endif
		
		return lRetorna
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cerrar
		if this.Buffer<>1
			if !this.YaGrabo .or. !this.YaRevirtio
				this.Revertir
			endif
		endif	
		this.seleccionar
		use
		this.SelecAnterior
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE desfiltrar
		local cAliasAnt
		
		cAliasAnt=alias()
		
		this.Seleccionar
		
		set filter to
		Select (cAliasAnt)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Destroy
		this.cerrar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Error
		LPARAMETERS nError, cMethod, nLine
		this.errorsis
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE errorsis
		local aerrores[6],mmensaje,nRetorna
		=aerror(aerrores)
		do case
			case aerrores[1]=1582
				mmensaje=dbgetprop(this.tabla+"."+aerrores[3],"field","ruletex")
			    mmensaje=STRTRAN(mmensaje, '"', '')
				=fMensAceptar(mmensaje)
			case aerrores[1]=1884
				=fMensAceptar(TG_REGISTRODUPLICADO)
				
			case aerrores[1]=4
				this.IrUltimo
			otherWise
				Error aerrores[1]
		
		endcase
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE esbof
		return bof(this.alias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE eseof
		return eof(this.alias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE esfinal
		local lUltimo
		
		lUltimo=.f.
		
		if !this.EsEof()
			this.IrSiguiente
		
			if this.EsEof()
				lUltimo=.t.
			endif
			
			this.IrAnterior
		else
			lUltimo=.t.
		endif
		return lUltimo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE esprincipio
		
		local lPrimero
		
		lPrimero=.f.
		
		if !this.EsBof()
			this.IrAnterior
		
			if this.EsBof()
				lPrimero=.t.
			else
				this.IrSiguiente
			endif
		else
			lPrimero=.t.
		endif
		return lPrimero
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE fijartag
		lparameters cTag
		Local cOldTag
		cOldTag=this.Tag
		set order to tag (cTag) in this.alias
		this.tag=ctag
		this.irPrimero
		Return cOldTag
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE filtrar
		lParameters cExpresion
		local cAliasAnt
		
		cAliasAnt=alias()
		
		this.Seleccionar
		set filter to &cExpresion
		select (cAliasAnt)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabar
		local lHayError
		lCorrecto=.t.
		if this.buffer<>1
			lCorrecto=tableupdate(1,.t.,this.alias)
			if !lCorrecto
				this.errorsis()
			else
				this.YaGrabo=.t.		
			endif
		
		
		endif
		return lCorrecto
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE haymodificaciones
		IF ISNULL(GETFLDSTATE(-1,this.alias))
		  RETURN .F.
		ELSE
		  RETURN ("2" $ GETFLDSTATE(-1,this.alias) OR ;
		          "4" $ GETFLDSTATE(-1,this.alias))
		ENDIF
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE incrementar		&& Incremento en uno un determinado campo
		lParameter cCampo
		Local mRetorna,vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		vGrabacion[1,1]=cCampo
		vGrabacion[1,2]=this.Leer(cCampo)+1
		
		this.LockReg()
		mRetorna=this.Leer(cCampo)
		this.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
		this.Unlock
		
		Return mRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lparameters ctabla,ctag,lExclusivo
		if type("cTag")=T_LOGICAL
			cTag=""
		endif
		this.buffer=1
		this.exclusivo=lExclusivo
		this.tag=cTag
		this.tabla=cTabla
		this.abrir(ctabla,ctag,lExclusivo)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE iranterior
		if !this.EsBof()
			skip -1 in (This.Alias)
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE irprimero
		go top in (This.Alias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE irregistro
		lparameters nRegistro
		go nRegistro in (this.alias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE irsiguiente
		skip in (This.Alias)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE irultimo
		go bottom in (This.Alias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE leer
		lparameters cCampo
		*local cDato
		*cDato=alltrim(this.alias)+"."+alltrim(cCampo)
		
		return eval(this.alias+"."+cCampo)
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE localizar
		lparameters cExpresion
		local cAliasAnt
		cAliasAnt=alias()
		
		this.Seleccionar
		locate for &cExpresion
		
		if cAliasAnt<>""
			select(cAliasAnt)
		endif
		
		Return !this.EsEof()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE lockarch
		return flock(this.alias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE lockreg
		if rlock(this.alias)
			return .t.
		else
			=fMensAceptar(TG_REGISTROLOCKEADO)
			return .f.
		endif
		return .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE modificar
		lparameters vDatos,lSinLockear,lResetearVector
		local cGrabacion
		
		cGrabacion=""
		
		for mmpp=1 to alen(vDatos,1)		
			mvaraux=vDatos[mmpp,2]
			do case
			
				case type("mvaraux")=T_CHARACTER
					mvaraux="'"+mvaraux+"'"
				case type("mvaraux")=T_NUMERIC	
					mvaraux=alltrim(str(mvaraux,15,10))		
				case type("mvaraux")=T_DATE			
					mvaraux="ctod('"+dtoc(mvaraux)+"')"
				case type("mvaraux")=T_LOGICAL	
					if mvaraux
						mvaraux=".t."
					Else
						mvaraux=".f."
					Endif		
					
			endcase	
		
		    cgrabacion=cGrabacion+","+alltrim(vDatos[mmpp,1])+" with "+mvaraux	
		endfor
		
		cGrabacion=substr(cGrabacion,2) && Saco la primera coma
		
		if !lSinLockear
			this.LockReg()
		Endif	
		replace &cGrabacion in (this.alias) 
		if !lSinLockear
			this.unlock
		Endif	
		if lResetearVector
			Dimension vDatos[1,2]
			vDatos[1,1]=.f.
			vDatos[1,2]=.f.
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE recno		&& Devuelve el numero de registro
		return recno(this.alias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE reindexar
		local cAliasAnt
		cAliasAnt=alias()
		
		if this.exclusivo
			select (this.alias)
			reindex
			select (cAliasAnt)
		else
			=messagebox("El archivo debe estar en modo esclusivo",0,"Abortado")
			=fMensAceptar(TG_ARCHIVONOEXCLUSIVO)
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE revertir
		lParameters lRevertirSoloFila
		if this.buffer<>1
			if lRevertirSoloFila
				=tablerevert(.f.,this.alias)
			else
				=tablerevert(.t.,this.alias)			
			endif	
			this.YaRevirtio=.t.
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE saltar
		lparameters nRegistros,cAlias
		if Type("cAlias")=T_LOGICAL
			cAlias=this.Alias
		Endif
		
		
		skip nRegistros in (cAlias)
		if this.EsEof()
			this.IrUltimo(cAlias)
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE selecanterior
		if alltrim(this.AliasAnt)<>"".and.used(this.AliasAnt)
			select(alltrim(this.AliasAnt))
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionar
		select (this.alias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearprop
		lparameters cCodigo
		local cPropiedad,nValor
		nValor=0
		cPropiedad=""
		Set Multilock on
		do case 
			case upper(cCodigo)="BOF"    && Buffer Optimista en filas
				cPropiedad="BUFFERING"
				nValor=3
			case upper(cCodigo)="BPF"	 && Buffer Pesimista en filas
				cPropiedad="BUFFERING"
				nValor=2
			case upper(cCodigo)="BOT"	 && Buffer Optimista en tablas
				cPropiedad="BUFFERING"
				nValor=5
			case upper(cCodigo)="BPT"    && Buffer Pesimista en Tablas
				cPropiedad="BUFFERING"
				nValor=4
			case upper(cCodigo)="BD"	 && Desactivar Buffer Pesimista en filas
				cPropiedad="BUFFERING"
				nValor=1
		endcase
		if substr(alltrim(ccodigo),1,1)="B"
			this.buffer=nValor
		endif		
		=cursorsetprop(cPropiedad,nValor,this.alias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE unlock
		unlock in (this.alias)
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_textgridbus AS tg_textbox OF "tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="textbox" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<PropValue>
		BackColor = 0,0,164
		BorderStyle = 0
		ForeColor = 255,255,255
		MousePointer = 1
		Name = "tg_textgridbus"
		ReadOnly = .T.
		SelectedBackColor = 0,0,164
		SpecialEffect = 1
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE DblClick
		thisform.tg_btnaceptar2.click
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE GotFocus
		thisform.lockscreen=.t.
		set cursor off
		thisform.recno=recno(thisform.archivo)
		mdato=thisform.archivo+"."+thisform.vcampos[thisform.tg_combobox1.listindex,1]
			
		thisform.tg_textbox1.value=&mdato
		*thisform.tg_grid1.refresh
		thisform.lockscreen=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		if nkeycode=13
			thisform.tg_btnaceptar2.click
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE LostFocus
		set cursor on
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_toolbarabm AS tg_toolbar OF "tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="toolbar" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="CmdFirst" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="cmdPrior" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="CmdNext" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="cmdLast" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Separator3" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="CmdNew" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="cmdEdit" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="cmdDelete" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Separator8" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Cmdsave" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="CmdUnddo" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Separator5" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Separator6" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="CmdClose" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Separator2" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Separator1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_toolboton1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*p: modoedicion
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		Caption = "Herramientas de Desplazamiento"
		ControlBox = .F.
		Height = 31
		Left = 0
		Name = "tg_toolbarabm"
		Top = -2
		Width = 278
	*</PropValue>

	ADD OBJECT 'CmdClose' AS tg_toolboton WITH ;
		Caption = "", ;
		Left = 218, ;
		Name = "CmdClose", ;
		Picture = ..\..\vfp\samples\mainsamp\bitmaps\close.bmp, ;

DEFINE CLASS tg_valdef AS tg_custom OF "tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="custom" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: cargardefault
		*p: id_clave
		*p: nombre
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		Name = "tg_valdef"
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE cargardefault
		lparameters cDato
		maliasant=alias()
		do case
		   case upper(cDato)="SUCURSAL"     
		   		use sucursal in 0 again  alias borrar
		   		cClave="001"
		   case upper(cDato)="DEPOSITO"   
		   		use deposito in 0 again alias borrar
		   		cClave="001"   		
		   case upper(cDato)="MONEDA"   
		   		use monedas in 0 again alias borrar
		   		cClave="D"   		
		   		
		endcase
		select borrar
		set order to tag "clave"
		seek cClave
		
		this.id_clave=cClave
		this.nombre=nombre
		
		select borrar
		use
		   		
		select (maliasant)
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="custom" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>

		*p: monedavisualizacion

	*<PropValue>

	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters Id_Comprobante,id_MonedaDeuda,nCotizacionDeuda,id_MonedaListaPrecios
	ENDPROC
